$comment: Metros that pass the generation gate in spec section 6-10-3: head-keyword volume measured at >= 500/month. A modelled median is not a measurement, so a metro is absent from this file until its own volume has been observed. Indices and rent stay null until the BEA and HUD datasets exist (13-6).
caveat: Three of the four measured metros are in Texas. That reflects which keywords were measured, not that Texas metros are uniquely valuable. Section 6-10-7 calls for 5 sample metros; a fifth outside Texas should be measured before the sample set is considered geographically representative.
